neighbours.label: the end piece of a compound organisation or brand name (I|stat, Eir|com, U|Connect, Euro|stat, Ros|stat)
fire: New figures from Eurostat showed a fall in exports.
A report by Rosstat put inflation at nine percent.
The firm bought Vodacom, a mobile operator in Africa.
Figures released by Sakstat showed a good grape harvest.
Students must log in to UConnect for the course.
According to Eurostat, wages rose in most countries.
The strike at Airtel entered its third week.
The study used the Istat survey of Italian households.
quiet: New figures from the bank showed a fall in exports.
A report by Reuters put inflation at nine percent.
The firm bought Barclays, a large lender in Africa.
Figures released by Google showed a good year.
Students must log in to Moodle for the course.
According to Microsoft, wages rose in most countries.
The strike at Boeing entered its third week.
The study used the census survey of Italian households.

short: end piece of an organisation name
notes: Card: ',' x8, 'in' x2, 'stat', 'com', '"', 'Connect', 'ron', 'inin'. Probes: 'stat' in Istat 1.015, 'com' in Eircom 0.465, 'Connect' in UConnect 0.364; 'istle' 0.160, ' Reuters' 0.099. Tokens are checked for each fire sentence. Near misses use whole-token organisations.
